cohort: The cohort consisted of 13 women of childbearing age with a stoma who had 16 pregnancies and births over a nine-year period at a major metropolitan hospital.
finding: Pregnancy in stoma patients is rare and associated with high rates of Caesarean sections, preterm delivery, low birth weight, and stomal complications.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates were very high, at 90% for IBD patients and 83% for non-IBD patients.
birth_weight: 40% of neonates born to IBD mothers and 33.3% born to non-IBD mothers had a birth weight under 2500g.
gest_age: Average gestational age at delivery was 36 weeks for IBD patients and 35 weeks for non-IBD patients.
